facts.fact: The UDSM DHIS2 Lab states that health data is entered into the national DHIS2 directly at facilities or at the district level, and that district-level health managers across 184 district councils open a user-support app inside DHIS2 to request dataset changes for about 9,000 facilities; it does not say the work is done at the council's own office or over what connection. No date is given for the statement, so the document's published date (itself a proxy) is used.
facts.system: DHIS2 entry and user support at district level

systems.owner: Ministry of Health; supported by the UDSM DHIS2 Lab
systems.tiers: Health facilities and district level, 184 district councils; national since 2010
District and facility health managers; in use since March 2022

note: The one fact is inferred from district-level online work in a national system; the document names no office connection and the parent should weigh whether it meets the 'at their own offices' test.
